ch2_lab_ip.q: True or False: If you're a professional developer working under a contract, you usually own the copyright to the code you write on the job.
ch2_lab_ip.explain: False — that's "Work Made for Hire." The company that paid for the work owns the copyright, not the person who wrote it.

ch2_lab_https.q: True or False: A site with no login form or payment processing doesn't really need HTTPS.
ch2_lab_https.explain: False — even a "read-only" site leaks a visitor's browsing behavior over plain HTTP. HTTPS isn't just for forms and logins.

ch2_lab_a11y.q: True or False: Adding alt text to every image is enough to make a website fully accessible.
ch2_lab_a11y.explain: False — alt text only solves the visual barrier. It does nothing for a deaf user who needs captions or a user with tremors who needs bigger click targets.
